# Terminal Source Snapshot

The unmodified `terminal.js` and `terminal.css` files were copied on 9 October 2026, and `terminal-text.js` on 11 October 2026, from Paul Parks's Parks Computing content source at `wwwroot/js/terminal.js`, `wwwroot/js/terminal-text.js` and `wwwroot/css/terminal.css`. They are copyright 2026 Paul Parks and licensed under Apache 2.0. The full license is in `LICENSE`.

Dinah's `terminal-applet.js` is a port of the shell in `terminal.js` and the text tools in `terminal-text.js`: the parser, wildcards, pipelines, redirection, scripts, the command model and its commands, the pager, the nano-style editor, line editing, history, completion, xterm setup and PUDL theme integration. Its `terminal.css` adapts the terminal screen and window layout. The snapshot files are kept for attribution and comparison and are not loaded by the application.

The port runs over Dinah's virtual file system through its Go bindings instead of the site's file system, and adds `;`, `&&`, `||`, variables and `<` input. Website routes, credentials, the site's applets, ssh and operating-system shell execution are not part of it.
